div.l: He kepte that he wan / in the pestelence
For gold in phisik / is a cordial
Ther he lovede gold / in special
A Wyf of BatheA Good wyf was ther / of besyde bathe
But she was somdel def / and that was skathe
Of clothe makyng / sche hadd such an haunt
She passed hem of yprys / and of gaunt
In all the paryssh / ne was ther wyff noon
That to thoffryng / bi fore here shulde goon
And yif ther dede / certeyn so wroth was she
That she was out / of all charyte
Here kevercheyuys / vel fyne were of groıı̄unde
I durste seyn they weyed / ten poıı̄unde
That on a sonday / were on here heed
Here hosyn were of fyn / skarlet reed
Wel streyht I tyed / and shoes goode and newe
Bolde was here face / and fayr / and reed was here hewe
She was a worthy woman / al here lyve
Housbondes at the chirche dore / she hadde had fyve
With oute other companye / in youthe
But therof nedeth nowht / to speke as nouthe
And thries had she ben / at Ierusalem
She hadde passed many / a strānge strem
At Rome she hadde be / and at Boleyne
In Galis at seint Iamys / and at Coleyne
She covde moche of / wandryng bi the weye
Cat tothed was she / sothly for to seye
Vp on an Ambler / esyly she sat
Wel I wympelid / and on here hed an hat
As brod as is a bokeler / or a targe
A foot mantil / a boute here hepes large
And on here feet / a peyre spores sharpe
In felawshepe / vel cowde she lawhe and carpe
Of remedyes of love / she knew ꝑperchaıı̄unce
For she cowde of that art / tholde daıı̄unce
